Subject: Update on Your Application for the Marketing Position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for applying for the Marketing position at our company. We appreciate the time and effort you invested in your application.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose profiles more closely align with our current needs. Please know that this decision is not a reflection of your skills or qualifications, which we found to be strong. Rather, we are looking for a specific combination of experience and fit for this particular role.

We wish you the very best in your job search and future professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
